headline: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) Is Up 30.3% After Record Q2 2026 Beat And Raised Full-Year Outlook
summary: Zebra Technologies Corporation reported past second-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to US$1,557 million and net income to US$233 million, driving basic earnings per share from continuing operations to US$4.89 from US$2.20 a year earlier. Alongside these record results, management raised full-year 2026 guidance for sales growth and profitability, pointing to broad-based demand and meaningful contributions from recent acquisitions such as Elo Touch.
